channel.title: Ahtesham Ahmad — Writing
channel.description: Technical writing on AI engineering, system architecture, and developer tooling.

item.title: WISC: A Context Engineering Framework for AI Agents
item.description: Write, Isolate, Select, Compress. How I reduced a 72KB always-loaded context to 11.7KB with zero capability loss.

item.title: Why Your AI Code Review Misses the Bugs That Ship
item.description: The gap between style linters and real production bugs. How cross-file taint tracking catches what ESLint can't.

item.title: Building a 5-Strategy JSON Parser for Unreliable LLM Output
item.description: Every AI agent tutorial assumes models return valid JSON. How progressive fallback parsing brought success from ~70% to ~95%.
